title: Horse wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Horse body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#C97B3B'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='20' ry='11' fill='#E8A55A'/>
  
  <!-- Back legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='78' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#A05A24'/>
  <rect x='58' y='78' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#A05A24'/>
  <!-- Hooves back -->
  <rect x='33' y='90' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6B3A12'/>
  <rect x='57' y='90' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6B3A12'/>
  
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='79' width='8' height='15' rx='3' fill='#C97B3B'/>
  <rect x='54' y='79' width='8' height='15' rx='3' fill='#C97B3B'/>
  <!-- Hooves front -->
  <rect x='39' y='90' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8B4A18'/>
  <rect x='53' y='90' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8B4A18'/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M22 60 Q10 58 8 70 Q6 82 14 80 Q12 70 20 68' fill='#8B4A18' stroke='#A05A24' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M60 58 Q66 48 64 38 L74 36 Q78 50 72 60 Z' fill='#C97B3B'/>
  <!-- Neck highlight -->
  <path d='M63 55 Q67 47 66 40 L71 39 Q74 50 70 58 Z' fill='#E8A55A'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='34' rx='14' ry='10' transform='rotate(-15 68 34)' fill='#C97B3B'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='38' rx='8' ry='6' transform='rotate(-10 79 38)' fill='#E8A55A'/>
  <!-- Nostril -->
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='39' rx='1.5' ry='1.5' fill='#8B4A18'/>
  
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='3' fill='#3B1A05'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='29' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Ear -->
  <path d='M60 26 Q58 16 63 20 Q65 24 64 28 Z' fill='#C97B3B'/>
  <path d='M61 25 Q60 19 63 22 Q64 25 63 27 Z' fill='#E8A55A'/>
  
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M58 28 Q54 32 56 38 Q53 42 55 46 Q52 50 54 54' fill='none' stroke='#8B4A18' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <path d='M60 22 L68 2 L78 22 Z' fill='#FF4D6A'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <path d='M63 16 L75 16' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M61.5 19.5 L76.5 19.5' stroke='#6BCBFF' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Hat pom-pom -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='3' r='4' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='2' r='1.5' fill='#FFF3A0'/>
  <!-- Hat brim/base -->
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='22' rx='9.5' ry='2.5' fill='#FF6B85'/>
  
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='95' rx='30' ry='3' fill='#6B3A12' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
